newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB's Meyer repeats 0.5 pct 97 GDP growth forecast.
newsitem.headline: SNB's Meyer repeats 0.5 pct 97 GDP growth forecast.

text.p: Swiss National Bank Chairman Hans Meyer reaffirmed the central bank's forecast that gross domestic product would rise a real 0.5 percent and inflation would be around 1.0 percent in 1997, a parliamentary committee said.

"The Swiss National Bank, like the cabinet, expects real growth of 0.5 percent in 1997 and 1.5 percent in 1998. Inflation should remain around one percent in the current year and climb to 1.5 percent next year," the upper house's finance committee said in a statement after Meyer had appeared before it.
"Interest rates may rise slightly as the consequence of an upturn," it added without elaborating.
